transmitted_inventory.camera_format: Simulated full-frame digital still camera, 36 x 24 mm sensor; orientation and effective image area follow the authored output crop.
transmitted_inventory.lens: Rectilinear prime lens with controlled distortion
transmitted_inventory.shot_scale: Complete authored still life with a clear subject, related studies and luminous breathing space. Keep every intended object and each rectangular sheet within the frame, with visible tabletop margins.
transmitted_inventory.viewpoint: Strict top-down overhead view: the camera is directly above the main support plane, its optical axis points perpendicularly down at the plane, and its sensor is parallel to that plane. Frame the complete arrangement, authored intervals and crop margin on both axes; camera height follows the final crop and object scale. Place the identifying surfaces of each object toward the camera and preserve coherent contact with the light-table.
transmitted_inventory.lighting_setup: Sources use nominal 5200 K white light. A continuous milky-white diffusing light-table fills the entire frame and supplies the dominant light from below, with a restrained cool-neutral atmosphere. Light passes upward through translucent materials: single sheets attenuate the field, overlaps become distinctly denser and darker, and lower graphite becomes paler through a covering sheet. A restrained broad diffusion panel above camera-left gives opaque objects readable reflection bands and fine edge highlights. Black cards shape selected dark reflections. Opaque bodies retain their material color and dark values, with local contact shading at their support surfaces.
transmitted_inventory.exposure_intent: Keep the luminous tabletop below clipping and separate the bare field, single translucent layers and darker overlaps. Preserve faint covered graphite, subtle paper fibers, dark opaque bodies and controlled metal highlights. Balance reflected fill against the dominant transmitted field so both material types remain readable.
transmitted_inventory.focus_and_depth: Keep the necessary identity-bearing upper surfaces and lower edges readable at their authored depths, including required objects near the frame corners. Let unimportant background detail recede.
transmitted_inventory.support_and_motion: Rigid overhead studio arm, static objects, remote release; motion is held still throughout the exposure.
transmitted_inventory.visible_result: A luminous milky, slightly cool light-table still life with complete subjects and rectangular study sheets, clearly darker paper overlaps, softened lower graphite, and grounded opaque objects retaining dark bodies and precise reflected highlights. Deliberate grouping and generous luminous intervals establish the viewing order.

diffused_paper_archive.camera_format: Simulated full-frame digital still camera, 36 x 24 mm sensor; orientation and effective image area follow the authored output crop.
diffused_paper_archive.lens: Rectilinear prime lens with controlled distortion
diffused_paper_archive.shot_scale: Full static arrangement of translucent paper layers and the authored opaque objects, with readable layer boundaries and useful luminous intervals.
diffused_paper_archive.viewpoint: Strict top-down overhead view: the camera is directly above the main support plane, its optical axis points perpendicularly down at the plane, and its sensor is parallel to that plane. The diffused light-table lies beneath the paper and objects. Fit the arrangement and crop margin on both axes. Orient the important sculpture, product or drawing surfaces toward the camera through their authored placement on the support, keeping pale marks and paper edges readable.
diffused_paper_archive.lighting_setup: Nominal 5000 K continuous sources. A large evenly diffused lightbox beneath the static arrangement supplies a milky luminous field with subtle tonal variation. Adjust its output so the field and pale drawings retain detail. Tracing-paper layers scatter and attenuate the transmitted light, with visible density changes across overlapping sheets. A restrained soft front-side fill reveals opaque paper, tools and their source-consistent finishes. Shape reflective edges with the apparent light-panel boundaries and selected dark cards. Keep local contact shading soft and readable.
diffused_paper_archive.exposure_intent: Retain separation among the luminous ground, single paper layers, overlapping regions, pale marks and opaque foreground. Balance lightbox output and surface fill to preserve useful shadow detail and the authored material colors.
diffused_paper_archive.focus_and_depth: Keep the necessary sheet edges, physical drawing layers and identifying object surfaces readable at final output size. Establish paper scattering through the authored layer arrangement and depth of field through the chosen focus plane.
diffused_paper_archive.support_and_motion: Rigid overhead support, static paper and objects, remote release. This starting exposure assumes that every required detail remains stationary throughout the exposure.
diffused_paper_archive.visible_result: A softly luminous milky field, translucent paper with distinct overlap density, readable pale drawings, grounded opaque objects with restrained surface detail, and fine local tonal transitions. Color relationships follow the authored subject and environment.

color_field_hero.camera_format: Simulated full-frame digital still camera, 36 x 24 mm sensor; orientation and effective image area follow the authored output crop.
color_field_hero.lens: Rectilinear prime lens with controlled distortion
color_field_hero.shot_scale: One complete hero object and enough of its chosen color environment to establish the authored material relationship.
color_field_hero.viewpoint: Strict top-down overhead view: the camera is directly above the main support plane, its optical axis points perpendicularly down at the plane, and its sensor is parallel to that plane. Adjust camera height, subject placement and crop so the visible product surfaces and surrounding colors carry their authored visual weights. Object height and position account for the perspective within this overhead view.
color_field_hero.lighting_setup: A fully lit rectangular diffusion panel above camera-left, large in apparent angle from the product, provides neutral 5200 K continuous light. Position a dark side card in the reflection of the selected curved region to define a neighboring dark band. The broad source gives soft cast-shadow transitions while reflective surfaces retain their authored highlight boundaries. The surrounding carrier receives the illumination appropriate to its authored material and color role.
color_field_hero.exposure_intent: Tune light output to preserve the product finish, useful highlight gradients and the chosen color hierarchy. Keep the relevant texture at its observed scale.
color_field_hero.focus_and_depth: Place focus through the necessary near and far product features, keeping their edges and markings readable at final viewing size. Supporting color fields may recede according to their informational role.
color_field_hero.support_and_motion: Rigid overhead stand, static object and carrier, remote release.
color_field_hero.visible_result: A distinct product, recognizable surface gloss and texture, intentional color relationships, and grounded contact.

archive_action.camera_format: Simulated full-frame digital still camera, 36 x 24 mm sensor; orientation and effective image area follow the authored output crop.
archive_action.lens: Rectilinear prime lens with controlled distortion
archive_action.shot_scale: Medium close view of the working area, hands and the object being inspected.
archive_action.viewpoint: Strict top-down overhead view: the camera is directly above the main support plane, its optical axis points perpendicularly down at the plane, and its sensor is parallel to that plane. Frame the hands and their intended movement above the light-table together with the object. Place the important inspection surface toward the camera and keep the required contact points within the chosen depth range and crop margin.
archive_action.lighting_setup: Sources share a nominal 5000 K daylight balance. Broad diffused continuous light-table below, with a soft lateral source to reveal fingers, paper edges and opaque tools. Increase continuous output as needed for the shorter exposure.
archive_action.exposure_intent: Balance the luminous carrier with useful hand and product detail; preserve important highlights and a coherent low-key foreground.
archive_action.focus_and_depth: Focus on the necessary contact or inspection surface; keep the important finger and tool or product feature readable through the chosen gesture, with gentle recession through supporting regions.
archive_action.support_and_motion: Rigid overhead camera support; this starting exposure serves a controlled inspection pause above the light-table. For a moving gesture, preserve its requested path, shorten exposure as needed and rebalance light or ISO.
archive_action.visible_result: Credible contact and grip, an identifiable inspection gesture, readable key fingers and product features, and motion rendering consistent with the authored action and lighting.

material_macro.camera_format: Simulated full-frame digital still camera, 36 x 24 mm sensor; orientation and effective image area follow the authored output crop.
material_macro.lens: Rectilinear macro lens with close focusing
material_macro.shot_scale: Detail crop of the chosen surface or join at a scale that keeps the requested microstructure readable in the final output; the parent object may extend beyond the frame.
material_macro.viewpoint: Strict top-down overhead view: the camera is directly above the main support plane, its optical axis points perpendicularly down at the plane, and its sensor is parallel to that plane. Select the detail through camera height, magnification and crop. Orient the required physical texture or join toward the camera through object placement. With known dimensions, match working clearance to coverage and lens capability; otherwise use the authored relative detail scale.
material_macro.lighting_setup: A broad lateral diffusion panel at nominal 5000 K creates a controlled reflection gradient across the selected surface or join. A dark side card preserves readable curvature and a weak white bounce keeps necessary recess detail. Set the reflected band along the important surface turn and preserve the observed finish and texture scale.
material_macro.exposure_intent: Tune source output to retain specular detail and local texture contrast while keeping the chosen tonal mood.
material_macro.focus_and_depth: Place the focal plane through the chosen physical texture, marking or join. Keep the required near and far parts readable and allow deliberate falloff elsewhere. Use a static focus-stack appearance only when a greater depth range is part of the brief.
material_macro.support_and_motion: Rigid overhead macro support or copy stand, static subject, remote release. Keep subject and lighting fixed for any planned focus stack.
material_macro.visible_result: The selected finish and join remain readable at output size, with source-consistent texture scale, coherent reflection transitions and continuous necessary edges through the chosen close-focus depth.
